name: reactive-resume
title: Reactive Resume
description: Free, privacy-first resume builder. Beautiful templates, a live preview, PDF export, a public link for every resume, and zero tracking. Your data never leaves your server.

variables.name: PORT_REACTIVE_RESUME
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port to expose Reactive Resume on

variables.name: RESUME_APP_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://resume.example.com. Sign-in and every shared resume link are built from it. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above

variables.name: RESUME_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: RESUME_AUTH_SECRET
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Signs the sign-in sessions. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: RESUME_ENCRYPTION_SECRET
variables.label: Encryption secret
variables.description: Encrypts what the app stores for its AI helpers. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: RESUME_DISABLE_SIGNUPS
variables.label: Close sign-ups
variables.description: Nobody new can make an account. Deploy with it off, make your own account, then turn it on and deploy again: your public resumes stay reachable

variables.name: RESUME_SMTP_HOST
variables.label: Mail server (optional)
variables.description: For verification and password mails. Empty: those mails are printed in the container's log instead

variables.name: RESUME_SMTP_USER
variables.label: Mail user
variables.description: The account at the mail server

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: a resume you share must open for anyone with its link, and the app has its own accounts (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
